BuddyHosting.metadataDescription: Turn the Korea you know and love into a personal experience for travelers with HanBuddy.

hero.title: Your everyday Korea can become someone’s favorite memory.
hero.description: Share the places, flavors, and moments you genuinely love. Create a small, personal experience and help travelers discover Korea through a local point of view.
hero.imageAlt: A local buddy introducing Korean market food to a small group of travelers in Seoul

benefits.title: You already know the Korea travelers are looking for.
benefits.description: You do not need to be a professional guide. Start with a corner of Korea you care about and a story you want to share.

share.title: Share what feels truly local
share.description: Turn your favorite neighborhood, food, hobby, or culture into an experience only a local could create.

connect.title: Meet people across cultures
connect.description: Welcome curious travelers, exchange perspectives, and create a moment that feels personal to everyone.

schedule.title: Host in your own rhythm
schedule.description: Create the experience you want and open schedules that work naturally with your day-to-day life.

ideas.title: The best experience starts with something you love.
ideas.description: A memorable activity can be simple. What matters is your local perspective and the way you help guests feel included.

baseball.title: Cheer like a local
baseball.description: Teach the chants, order stadium favorites, and share the energy of a Korean baseball night.
baseball.imageAlt: Travelers and local buddies enjoying a Korean baseball game together

picnic.title: Share your favorite Seoul evening
picnic.description: Plan a Han River picnic, neighborhood walk, or sunset route with the details only locals know.
picnic.imageAlt: Friends enjoying a picnic together beside the Han River

food.title: Tell the story behind the food
food.description: Introduce a market, café, or comfort food through the memories and customs that make it meaningful.
food.imageAlt: A local buddy sharing Korean market food with travelers

steps.title: From a local idea to a hosted experience.
steps.description: Build your buddy profile, shape your activity, and manage the experience from one place.

profile.title: Create your buddy profile
profile.description: Tell travelers who you are and how they can stay in touch with you.

design.title: Design your experience
design.description: Add the story, meeting place, price, photos, and details guests need to decide.

publish.title: Open a schedule
publish.description: Choose the dates and capacity that work for you, then make the activity available to travelers.

host.title: Meet and host
host.description: Review applications, welcome your guests, and create a Korea story worth remembering.

support.title: Host with clarity from the first idea to the final meetup.
support.description: HanBuddy keeps the practical parts together so you can focus on the people and the experience itself.

manage.title: Keep activities and schedules organized
manage.description: Create activities, check their status, and manage upcoming schedules in your buddy workspace.

communicate.title: Know who is joining
communicate.description: Review guest applications and the details you need before the experience begins.

grow.title: Improve every time you host
grow.description: Update your activity as you learn what helps guests feel more welcome and connected.

finalCta.title: What part of Korea would you love to share?
finalCta.description: Start your buddy account and turn a place, taste, or everyday passion into a HanBuddy experience.
